content:
# Conceptual documentation

Welcome to the conceptual documentation for the Model Context Protocol SDK. Here you'll find high-level overviews, explanations, and guides to help you understand how the SDK implements the Model Context Protocol.

## Contents

### Getting started

To install the SDK and build your first MCP client and server, see [Getting started](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/csharp-sdk/blob/79e13b3e2c35300551ee2af4642e5f35d468ceb5/docs/concepts/getting-started.md).

### Deployment

| Title | Description |
| - | - |
| [Docker deployment](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/csharp-sdk/blob/79e13b3e2c35300551ee2af4642e5f35d468ceb5/docs/concepts/deployment/docker.md) | Learn how to package and run ASP.NET Core MCP servers in Docker containers using Streamable HTTP transport. |

### Base protocol

| Title | Description |
| - | - |
| [Capabilities](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/csharp-sdk/blob/79e13b3e2c35300551ee2af4642e5f35d468ceb5/docs/concepts/capabilities/capabilities.md) | Learn how client and server capabilities are negotiated during initialization, including protocol version negotiation. |
| [Transports](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/csharp-sdk/blob/79e13b3e2c35300551ee2af4642e5f35d468ceb5/docs/concepts/transports/transports.md) | Learn how to configure stdio, Streamable HTTP, and SSE transports for client-server communication. |
| [Stateless and Stateful](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/csharp-sdk/blob/79e13b3e2c35300551ee2af4642e5f35d468ceb5/docs/concepts/stateless/stateless.md) | Learn when to use stateless vs. stateful mode for HTTP servers and how to configure sessions. |
| [Ping](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/csharp-sdk/blob/79e13b3e2c35300551ee2af4642e5f35d468ceb5/docs/concepts/ping/ping.md) | Learn how to verify connection health using the ping mechanism. |
| [Progress tracking](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/csharp-sdk/blob/79e13b3e2c35300551ee2af4642e5f35d468ceb5/docs/concepts/progress/progress.md) | Learn how to track progress for long-running operations through notification messages. |
| [Cancellation](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/csharp-sdk/blob/79e13b3e2c35300551ee2af4642e5f35d468ceb5/docs/concepts/cancellation/cancellation.md) | Learn how to cancel in-flight MCP requests using cancellation tokens and notifications. |
| [Multi Round-Trip Requests (MRTR)](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/csharp-sdk/blob/79e13b3e2c35300551ee2af4642e5f35d468ceb5/docs/concepts/mrtr/mrtr.md) | Learn how servers request client input during tool execution using input-required results and retries. |

### Client features

| Title | Description |
| - | - |
| [Sampling](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/csharp-sdk/blob/79e13b3e2c35300551ee2af4642e5f35d468ceb5/docs/concepts/sampling/sampling.md) | Learn how servers request LLM completions from the client using the sampling feature. |
| [Roots](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/csharp-sdk/blob/79e13b3e2c35300551ee2af4642e5f35d468ceb5/docs/concepts/roots/roots.md) | Learn how clients provide filesystem roots to servers for context-aware operations. |
| [Elicitation](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/csharp-sdk/blob/79e13b3e2c35300551ee2af4642e5f35d468ceb5/docs/concepts/elicitation/elicitation.md) | Learn how to request additional information from users during interactions. |

### Server features

| Title | Description |
| - | - |
| [Tools](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/csharp-sdk/blob/79e13b3e2c35300551ee2af4642e5f35d468ceb5/docs/concepts/tools/tools.md) | Learn how to implement and consume tools that return text, images, audio, and embedded resources. |
| [Resources](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/csharp-sdk/blob/79e13b3e2c35300551ee2af4642e5f35d468ceb5/docs/concepts/resources/resources.md) | Learn how to expose and consume data through MCP resources, including templates and subscriptions. |
| [Prompts](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/csharp-sdk/blob/79e13b3e2c35300551ee2af4642e5f35d468ceb5/docs/concepts/prompts/prompts.md) | Learn how to implement and consume reusable prompt templates with rich content types. |
| [Completions](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/csharp-sdk/blob/79e13b3e2c35300551ee2af4642e5f35d468ceb5/docs/concepts/completions/completions.md) | Learn how to implement argument auto-completion for prompts and resource templates. |
| [Logging](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/csharp-sdk/blob/79e13b3e2c35300551ee2af4642e5f35d468ceb5/docs/concepts/logging/logging.md) | Learn how to implement logging in MCP servers and how clients can consume log messages. |
| [Pagination](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/csharp-sdk/blob/79e13b3e2c35300551ee2af4642e5f35d468ceb5/docs/concepts/pagination/pagination.md) | Learn how to use cursor-based pagination when listing tools, prompts, and resources. |
| [HTTP Context](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/csharp-sdk/blob/79e13b3e2c35300551ee2af4642e5f35d468ceb5/docs/concepts/httpcontext/httpcontext.md) | Learn how to access the underlying `HttpContext` for a request. |
| [MCP Server Handler Filters](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/csharp-sdk/blob/79e13b3e2c35300551ee2af4642e5f35d468ceb5/docs/concepts/filters.md) | Learn how to add filters to the handler pipeline. Filters let you wrap the original handler with additional functionality. |

### Extensions

| Title | Description |
| - | - |
| [MCP Apps](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/csharp-sdk/blob/79e13b3e2c35300551ee2af4642e5f35d468ceb5/docs/concepts/apps/apps.md) | Learn how to use the MCP Apps extension to deliver interactive UIs from MCP servers. |
| [Tasks](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/csharp-sdk/blob/79e13b3e2c35300551ee2af4642e5f35d468ceb5/docs/concepts/tasks/tasks.md) | Learn how to use task-based execution for long-running operations that can be polled for status and results. |
| [Identity and Roles](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/csharp-sdk/blob/79e13b3e2c35300551ee2af4642e5f35d468ceb5/docs/concepts/identity/identity.md) | Learn how to access caller identity and roles in MCP tool, prompt, and resource handlers. |
